articles.title: Why the Black Sea Is So Dangerous Right Now — And Why It Affects Your Bread
articles.summary: The Black Sea is the most dangerous it has been since the war in Ukraine began. More than 210 strikes hit ships between July and September. Russia and Ukraine grow a quarter of the world's wheat, and exports are down 60%.

articles.title: Judge Pauses Border Wall Construction in Texas' Big Bend for Now
articles.summary: A federal judge temporarily blocked the Trump administration from building a border wall across Texas' Big Bend region. The area includes Big Bend National Park and stretches about 500 miles. The judge said opponents could suffer serious harm without a pause.

articles.title: Ebola Outbreak in Congo Passes 4,000 Deaths
articles.summary: Congo's Ebola outbreak has killed more than 4,000 people — the fastest-growing ever. Health workers are protesting because they haven't been paid for months, and a treatment camp was burned down.
